test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which scheme focuses on the development of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) through targeted interventions?

options.text: Pradhan Mantri Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana** (VKY) was launched by the **Ministry of Tribal Affairs** in **2014** as a comprehensive scheme to improve the quality of life of tribal people, especially focusing on **Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs)**.
 
• The scheme aims at **holistic development** by addressing critical areas such as education, health, nutrition, livelihood, housing, and infrastructure for tribal communities.
 
• VKY focuses on **converging resources** from existing government schemes and programs to ensure that tribal development is inclusive and targeted. *Hence, it is the correct option.*
 
• The scheme emphasizes on **area-specific interventions** based on the needs of tribal groups, ensuring that no tribal community is left behind in development initiatives.
 
• Under VKY, special attention is paid to **education and skill development** to empower tribal youth and improve their employability. This is crucial for improving socio-economic conditions. *Hence, this scheme is highly effective for PVTGs.*
 
• The scheme also ensures that tribal communities have access to **basic services** such as drinking water, sanitation, electricity, and healthcare facilities, thereby improving their standard of living.
 
• It seeks to **protect tribal culture** while ensuring socio-economic development, thus maintaining the unique identity of tribal groups. *Hence, VKY aligns well with the question’s focus.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan:**

 
 
• This is not an actual scheme launched by the government. However, it may sound similar to welfare programs aimed at tribal communities. It is not relevant to the **PVTGs** focus.
 
 
 
• **Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission:**
 
 
• This mission aims at developing rural areas by providing urban-like infrastructure and amenities to bridge the urban-rural divide. It is not specifically targeted at tribal communities or **PVTGs**.
 
 
 
• **National Rural Livelihood Mission:**
 
 
• This scheme is aimed at improving rural livelihoods by promoting self-employment and skill development. While tribal groups might benefit, this scheme is not exclusively focused on **PVTGs**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs):**

 
 
• There are **75 PVTGs** identified by the Government of India. These groups have been categorized based on **pre-agricultural practices, low population, and extremely low levels of literacy**.
 
• PVTGs require **special attention** as they face challenges such as poor health conditions, lack of education, and socio-economic vulnerabilities.
 
 
 
• **Role of Ministry of Tribal Affairs:**
 
 
• The **Ministry of Tribal Affairs** is responsible for implementing schemes and policies for the welfare of tribal communities, including **PVTGs**.
 
• Examples of other tribal-focused schemes include **Educational scholarships, Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS), and Tribal Sub-Plan (TSP).**
